_meta.title: Suggestions and decisions
_meta.note: These are reviewable suggestions, not owner decisions. The local measurement prototype is present but disabled and unhosted; its event names remain a proposal. Repository state is cited separately from official policy and listing sources.

decisions.question: How should each of the five submitted links be validated for intended product and Associates attribution?
options: A. After the owner confirms each intended ASIN, generate one Associates Special Link per product in the enrolled marketplace workflow; check each destination against that intended listing and check report attribution before scaling.
B. Keep each supplied short link recorded as submitted and its exact compliance status unresolved; do not silently replace it or describe it as invalid.
C. Leave any unconfirmed intended ASIN and product-specific CTA blank/flagged until the owner confirms intent and the one-link-per-product test is recorded.
decisions.suggested: A for each confirmed intended product, one at a time; preserve the supplied links separately and do not scale until destination and report checks pass.
decisions.needs: Owner-confirmed intended ASINs, access to the enrolled Associates account and marketplace, and a recorded destination/report check for each product.

sources.label: Associates Program Policies (Special Link and attribution requirements; SH-S02)
Shop intent/observed records; current owner intent remains blank

decisions.question: What is the intended ASIN and official listing URL for each of the five submitted links?
options: A. The requester confirms each intended product/ASIN; then check its official listing and record date/source in the intent fields.
B. Copy the observed redirect target into intended fields. Not suggested: a redirect is not an owner statement of intent.
C. Keep the intended fields blank and flagged until confirmation; retain the observed target separately.
decisions.needs: The requester’s statement for all five links; the repository must keep confirmed intended fields separate from the five dated observed targets.

decisions.question: How should site activity and conversions be measured, if at all?
options: A. Keep the campaign ledger empty until an authorized Associates first-party report is available; add only dated report values with provenance.

B. Review the five event definitions already recorded as a proposal in data/shop/measurement.json. The generated counter config is OFF and endpoint_url is empty; the local collector script is not a hosted service. Do not enable until an owner-selected runtime and its actual logs, IP handling, retention, access controls and notice/consent requirements are reviewed.
C. Consider both only after the owner accepts/revises the event schema and the deployed runtime passes the host/privacy review; keep order/conversion values report-sourced, not browser events.
decisions.suggested: A for current reporting; keep the counter OFF. B/C remain proposals until the host and its real logging/retention behavior are verified.
decisions.needs: Owner decision on the proposed event names/fields; a selected and deployed request-handling runtime; actual network/access-log and retention evidence; and authorized Associates reports for conversions.

decisions.question: What human-reviewed publishing cadence can the owner sustain?
options: A. One question-led guide every 14 days, only after a real editor is named and each guide receives human review.
B. A slower cadence selected by the owner after editorial capacity is known.
C. Publish only when an approved guide has a source-backed reason to exist; choose later topics from dated query evidence when available.
decisions.suggested: No cadence is adopted. Name a real editor first; use query evidence for topic selection when it exists. The 14-day interval is a proposal only.
decisions.needs: A real editor/reviewer and an owner-approved, sustainable schedule. Search demand is not measured in this repository.

sources.label: FTC Endorsements, Influencers, and Reviews guidance (truthful endorsement context; S24)
Cadence and reviewer are still proposals/open inputs

decisions.question: Which buyer-question guide should be prioritized first, and in which category?
options: A. “Basket or oven-style air fryer: what should you compare?”
B. “A no-hype checklist for comparing air fryer capacity.”
C. “How to assess cleanup and counter-space trade-offs.”
D. “What should you compare between instant-read and wireless meat thermometers?”
E. Hold topic ordering until the owner confirms category scope and a dated query baseline exists.
decisions.suggested: These are editorial hypotheses, not claims about popularity, search volume, or product superiority. Keep the two observed categories distinct until scope is confirmed.
decisions.needs: Owner-confirmed audience/category scope and, for measured-demand ordering, a dated query report. No query volume is currently recorded.

decisions.question: Which disclosure wording should appear?
options: A. The exact sentence in Operating Agreement Section 5 (in use).
B. A paraphrase.

questions.question: Which intended ASIN and official listing URL did the requester mean for each of the five submitted links?
questions.have: The shop register records five submitted links and dated observed destinations; all five intended-ASIN fields are blank.
questions.missing: The owner’s product intent for each link; a redirect is not proof of intent.
questions.how_to_find: Ask the requester to confirm each product, then verify the official listing and record intended ASIN/URL/date/source separately from observed target.

questions.question: Does one Associates-generated Special Link per confirmed intended product reach the right listing and appear in the report?
questions.have: shopnow047c-20 is recorded as requester-supplied; no account ownership, marketplace or per-product report test is verified.
questions.missing: Account verification plus destination/report attribution for one Special Link per owner-confirmed product.
questions.how_to_find: Verify the tracking ID and marketplace in the enrolled account; create and test one Special Link per intended product before scaling. Keep supplied links unchanged and unresolved.

questions.question: Does shopnow047c-20 belong to the requester’s enrolled Associates account and chosen marketplace?
questions.have: The current config records shopnow047c-20 as a requester-supplied value, not as a verified account credential.
questions.missing: Account ownership, marketplace association, enrollment and tracking report attribution.
questions.how_to_find: Check account settings in Associates Central and record the owner’s confirmation; do not embed or rewrite links based on the string alone.

questions.question: Which marketplace and audience should the site serve?
questions.have: All five dated observed destinations are Amazon.com pages. This does not establish target market, audience, currency or enrolled marketplace.
questions.missing: Owner choice of audience/marketplace and a matching enrolled account.
questions.how_to_find: Ask the owner and verify the chosen Associates marketplace in the account; do not infer it from the current destinations or the requester’s physical location.

questions.question: What five measurement events, if any, should be approved, and where can a host run?
questions.have: Five definitions exist in the repository as a proposal; the counter config is disabled with empty endpoint_url and the collector is unhosted. GitHub Pages is static and its documentation notes visitor IP logging.
questions.missing: Owner approval/revision, deployed runtime, actual host/network logs, IP handling, retention, access controls and applicable notice/consent review. No authorized report is present.
questions.how_to_find: Review data/shop/measurement.json as a proposal only; keep collection OFF. Verify official host docs and real staging/network logs before activation. Use authorized Associates reports for conversions.
